pdf.ocr.recognizeTitle: Reads the text of the pages without a text layer, on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
pdf.ocr.pageOffer: This page is an image without a text layer. Recognize its text to search it and to link board references.
pdf.ocr.documentOffer: No text layer: this is a scanned or raster PDF. Open it in the viewer and press Recognize text to search it and to link board references.
pdf.ocr.linkRule: Recognized words are marked. Only exact board names read with a confidence of at least {floor}% become links.
pdf.ocr.cancelled: Text recognition stopped after {done} of {total} pages. Recognized pages stay searchable.
pdf.ocr.timeouts: Pages not recognized within the time limit: {pages}
pdf.ocr.unavailable: Text recognition is not available here: {message}
pdf.ocr.badgeTitle: Text recognized by OCR on this computer, average confidence {confidence}%
pdf.addNote: Add note (then click the page to place it)
pdf.addNoteKeyboard: Add note at the center of the view
pdf.noteCancel: Click a page to place the note, Esc to cancel
pdf.noTextLayer: No text layer: this is a scanned or raster PDF, so text search is unavailable. The pages can still be viewed.
pdf.truncated: Text index truncated: only the first {done} of {total} pages are searchable.
pdf.indexFailed: Text indexing failed; search results may be incomplete.
pdf.noBookmarks: No bookmarks yet. Add one at the current position.
pdf.noNotes: No notes yet. Use "Add note" and click a page.
pdf.passwordWrong: That password is not correct. Try again.
pdf.errorTitle: The PDF could not be opened
pdf.closedHint: Reopen it from the document list.
pdf.renderFailed: This page could not be rendered.
